author: real_bound_boundary
body: Architecture audit (cursor 1548): `proof_contract_recognition._recognize_estimate` is intentionally Nat-specific at several independent gates: initial telescope admits only domain head Nat; conclusion requires `LE.le` plus builtin Nat order; left estimate requires scale/input Nat and direct binders; right estimate requires builtin Nat multiplication; `_scale_offset` supplies natural literal offset. Replacing only those checks risks admitting a different proposition under identical Nat rules. Record validation is also single-profile closed: `proof_contracts.validate_contract` rejects profileId other than norm-scale-v1, with one shared `_RECORD_KEYS`/`_FEATURE_KEYS` algebra. `proof_contract_rules.PROFILE_DIGEST` is imported by production envelopes, formal snapshot validation, payload validation, comparison, propagation, obligations, probes, artifacts; several bridge/probe consumers explicitly hard-code norm-scale-v1. Therefore profile support requires discriminated dispatch at record validation AND per-artifact profile digest; changing the digest constant globally would invalidate historical meanings. Typed source observation should be a distinct status/data variant from admitted semantic contract: preserve arbitrary real AST refs/guards/scope and residuals, but do not serialize it as Nat `features.regularity`/constant permissions or let existing Nat rules consume it. General first slice: add closed real-bound record with own profile digest and exact typed fields (carrier/order/scalar/operator/predicate/function/set/index/constant/guards/telescope/source refs/admission states); producer emits only observed structure + unresolved predicate/law obligations absent concrete Lean checks. Permit one real consumer first: exact comparison/report rendering that returns unknown when admission unresolved, or direct admitted contract comparison only after same checked admission identity; propagation remains unsupported until checked generic laws exist. Independent fixtures should prove generic admission facts: `∀ j≤r` prefix and p∈S,Y coverage; real bound weakening, order-prefix weakening, multiplication/composition laws; nonnegative K witness selected after fixed parameter/n but before f/S/C; fake same-named predicate with altered definition; guard polarity and binder-order mutations. High-risk promotions: using Nat casts/mul laws for ℝ; accepting names/substrings as definitions; treating `∃ K` later in telescope as uniform; discarding `0≤K`, regularity or `0≤C`; comparing unlike operators or sets by label; paper norm bridge and 4/5 loss confusion. No edits, tests, dependencies. Baseline hash manifest unchanged per assignment.

author: real_bound_red
body: Challenge/reconciliation (cursor 1549): I agree on strict profile dispatch, Nat-specific gate inventory, and separating observed typed shape from admitted semantics. Tighten first slice: avoid claiming a `real-bound-v1` semantic contract where admission is unresolved; call it an observation/source-shape variant, or use an explicit closed status that existing `validate_contract` rejects. I recommend the first exercised consumer be native record validation + inspection/report projection returning unresolved, because an admitted-only comparator still risks semantic interpretation and requires comparison schema changes. Conversely, avoid implementing even direct comparison before predicate admission law evidence exists. My control suite adds missing/relocated K and C sign guards, negation/disjunction polarity, and exact f/S/operator/set mismatch. These are AST-shape discriminators, not proof of source fidelity. A same-named fake needs definition digest/actual environment admission mismatch; synthetic dicts cannot prove that check, so pair AST tests with a Lean-backed definition/law fixture before any admission succeeds. No tests run; proposed file is `.codex/state/real-bound-contracts/red/acceptance-proposal.md`.

Current useful seam is proof_contract_production._consume_worker_observation -> proof_contract_recognition._recognize_estimate(normalizedTypeExpr); preserve that private Nat recognizer meaning and add a separate real recognizer/producer dispatch. Exact Expr AST constructors and the existing Nat grammar plus acceptance/control matrix are documented at `.codex/state/real-bound-contracts/red/acceptance-proposal.md`. Baseline: `.codex/state/real-bound-contracts/baseline.json`; read-only source/test inspection. Commands: `sed`/`rg` on proof_contract_recognition.py, proof_contract_expressions.py, proof_contract_production.py, proof_contract_formal.py, tests/test_proof_contract_production.py; no tests run. Dependencies: none added (Python fixture builder; Lean required only to evidence successful definition/law admission, under parent 12 GiB cap). No production or test-tree edits and no shared builds. Generality controls cover arbitrary names, literal shifts 0/4/7, symbolic offset, fake same-name predicate, binder scope, sign guards, polarity, and typed f/S/operator/set identities. Challenge/reconciliation with boundary scout is #1550: agree separate observations/admissions and closed profile dispatch; prefer native validation/inspection reporting unresolved as first consumer; no admitted comparator or propagation until checked meaning/laws exist. Remaining gate: root API/schema choice; synthetic Expr controls alone do not establish source fidelity or predicate semantics; add a Lean-backed exact definition/environment/law fixture before any positive admission. Historical norm-scale-v1 compatibility and all digest/consumer dispatch require root-owned verification.

The source-definition digest/environment/law checks need a separate Lean-backed admission fixture; AST dictionaries only test extraction/guard/scope shapes. The existing profile imports make this a multi-consumer compatibility boundary, so pin old profile artifacts and prove old snapshots still validate byte-for-byte before enabling new variant. No implementation/test changes.
